name: Techno — تكنو

description: An electronics & gadgets theme: navy header and footer, electric-blue primary with cyan accents, light-grey page, sharp technical typography, spec chips and price/discount emphasis on cards, compare tray, category mega-menu, support hotline, trust bar, flash deals with countdown and a brand wall — built entirely on the shared section library.

question.en: Are devices genuine and covered by the official warranty?

answer.ar: نعم، جميع منتجاتنا أصلية ١٠٠٪ وبضمان الوكيل المعتمد لمدة سنتين.
answer.en: Yes — every product is 100% genuine and carries the authorised two-year warranty.

answer.ar: اختر تابي أو تمارا عند الدفع وقسّم المبلغ حتى ١٢ شهراً بدون فوائد.
answer.en: Pick Tabby or Tamara at checkout and split the total over up to 12 months at 0%.

answer.ar: التوصيل خلال ٢٤ ساعة داخل المدن الرئيسية و٢-٤ أيام لبقية المناطق.
answer.en: Next-day in major cities and 2–4 days elsewhere.

question.ar: هل يمكن إرجاع جهاز تم فتحه؟
question.en: Can I return an opened device?

answer.ar: نعم خلال ١٤ يوماً بشرط سلامة الجهاز وكامل الملحقات.
answer.en: Yes, within 14 days as long as the device and all accessories are intact.
